trace.query: What are the sanctions for a first offense of cyber bullying?

SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.

Sec. 1. Acts of Cybercrime (Stipulated by RA 10175 or the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012).

1.1. Cyber bullying or bullying done through the use of technology or any electronic means
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.2. Illegal access or hacking to the whole or any part of one’s online accounts including e -mail, social media profiles, etc.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.3. Illegal interception or listening to, recording, monitoring or surveillance of the content of communications, either directly through the access and use of computer systems, or indirectly through the use of electronic eavesdropping or tapping devices
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_506
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
exhibition of sexual organs or sexual activity, with the aid of a computer system, for favor or consideration.
 Sanction (all offenses): expulsion from the University

1.7. Child Pornography, including unlawful and prohibited acts defined and punishable by RA 9775 or the Anti-Child Pornography Act of 2009, committed through a computer system.
 Sanction (all offenses): expulsion from the University

1.8. Cyber Libel or the unlawful or prohibited acts of libel as defined in Article 355 of the Revised Penal Code, committed through a computer system or any other similar means.
 Sanction (all offenses): expulsion from the University

1.9. Aiding, abetting or attempting to willfully commit any of the offenses enumerated as acts of cybercrime shall be held liable.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 3rd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

Sec. 2. Belligerence and Discourtesy. Defiant attitude indicated by acts of belligerence, gross and deliberate discourtesy toward fellow student, teachers, employees and other University authorities.

The following acts are strictly prohibited.
directly through the access and use of computer systems, or indirectly through the use of electronic eavesdropping or tapping devices
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.4. Data interference or the intentional or reckless alteration, damaging, deletion or deterioration of computer data, electronic document or electronic message, without right, including introduction or transmission of viruses
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

1.5. Computer-related fraud, forgery and identity theft or the intentional acquisition, use, misuse, transfer, possession, alteration or deletion of identifying information belonging to another person.

1.6. Cybersex or the willful engagement, maintenance, control or operation, directly or indirectly, of any lascivious exhibition of sexual organs or sexual activity, with the aid of a computer system, for favor or consideration.
 Sanction (all offenses): expulsion from the University

1.7.

SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
possessing of cards or any gambling paraphernalia within the University premises.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

Sec. 9. Indecency and Obscenity. Engaging in indecent, obscene conduct and activities which include possessing and/or circulating pornographic/trashy literature and pictures, using indecent language and doing similar acts. (PD No. 960 as amended by PD No. 969)

9.1. Directed against the faculty, staff, student, visitors and any person in authority which include sex video scandals
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

9.2. Uploading, downloading and sharing sex video scandals.
 Sanction (all offenses): Suspension for one (1) month

9.3. Surfing of pornographic pictures and posting of lustful photos in the internet while within the university premises.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 3rd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

Sec. 10.

SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
within the University premises any firearm/s, knife with a blade longer than 2- 1/2 inches, ice pick, explosive/s or any other dangerous or deadly weapon/s is a major offense. However, this provision shall not apply to anyone who possesses bolo/s and other monitored tools in connection with his/her studies or field of activities. Case of unauthorized possession of firearms shall be reported to Safety and Security Management Office.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) year
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

Sec. 5. Bullying (RA 10627 or the Anti-Bullying Act of 2013)

5.1. Any severe or repeated use of written or verbal expression, physical act or gesture, or a combination thereof that is directed against another student, causing or placing the latter in reasonable fear of physical or emotional harm or damage to his/her property.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 3rd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

5.2.
